items.question: What penalty does the MSA impose if Harrowgate notifies a personal data breach late?
items.answer: The Harrowgate MSA requires the Provider to notify the Client of a personal data breach without undue delay and in any event within forty-eight (48) hours of becoming aware of it [1]. The documents in this matter do not specify a penalty for late notification.
